title: Tubes in the soft-white world, colour as light
question: Your two references: one white material, pushed out and pressed in, and colour only as light. Four ways the light can carry the value. Pick one, or steer.

options.label: Light inside the tube
options.thesis: The channel is pressed in and the amount glows inside it, brightest at the surface line.
options.viewport: Four channels, glow to the level, grey type.
options.risk: The most colour of the four; closest to the glass version we already built.

options.label: Light behind the capsule
options.thesis: The capsules stay white and rise out of the surface; a halo escapes from behind each one up to its level.
options.viewport: White capsules, coloured light on the white around them.
options.risk: The level is read from the glow's height, not from a filled bar; it is a softer reading.

options.label: A dot at the level
options.thesis: The slider from your second reference: a channel, and one small glowing dot where the value sits.
options.viewport: Almost entirely white; four dots carry the day.
options.risk: The quietest and the least glanceable: no volume, only a position.

options.label: Light at the surface line
options.thesis: A white bar rises inside the channel and the light glows only in the gap above it, marking exactly where today stands.
options.viewport: White on white, one line of colour per tube.
options.risk: The gap is thin; on a small screen the colour may be too faint to notice.
